title: salvia microphylla var. neurepia
intro: Salvia microphylla var. neurepia, commonly known as Red Salvia or New South Wales Salvia, is a flowering plant species within the sage genus. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Salvia microphylla var. neurepia are attributed to its ability to act as an anxiolytic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
